question: Should OpenClaw sponsor `append` as a permanent built-in write-tool parameter and `SandboxFsBridge.appendFile` as an optional Plugin SDK capability?
rationale: Correctness and security evidence are strong, but code review cannot authorize durable model-facing and external plugin contracts without owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor and reopen
options.body: Accept both additive contracts and reopen this PR for a current-main refresh and normal exact-head merge gates.

options.title: Request a narrower successor
options.body: Keep native append in an owner-approved internal boundary while deferring or redesigning the public Plugin SDK capability.

options.title: Leave the direction closed
options.body: Keep append outside the built-in write contract and use plugin-provided tools or explicit shell workflows instead.

recommendation.title: Sponsor and reopen
recommendation.body: Accept both additive contracts and reopen this PR for a current-main refresh and normal exact-head merge gates.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history spans the sandbox bridge, pinned mutation security boundary, and OpenShell backend affected by this contract choice.
